title: JoernCpgIndexContribution
description: Sealed, byte-stable handle + manifest for a raw Joern Code Property Graph (CPG) artefact produced by `joern-parse` / `joern-export`. The CPG file itself lives in the BundleStore and is referenced by `nativeAttributes.blobHandle`. Pattern-C universal envelope (SKILL §8bis Rule 2). PRODUCER RULE: this slot has exactly ONE producer per language scope (`JoernKS` in v1); other KSs that need inter-procedural call/dataflow facts MUST consume this slot rather than running their own CPG.

id.description: Stable client-defined identity within (panel, slot). Suggested form: '<toolName>|<toolVersion>|<projectRoot>|<indexedRevision>'.

tool.description: Pattern-C discriminator (§8bis Rule 2). Identifies the CPG-producing tool.

projectRoot.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the project root the tool was invoked on.

indexedRevision.description: Git revision of the working tree the tool ran on. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

languageScope.description: Set of source languages effectively covered (e.g. 'java', 'kotlin', 'javascript', 'python', 'c', 'go').

exportFormat.description: Format of the exported CPG payload. 'cpg-bin' for the native binary; 'graphml' / 'graphson' / 'neo4jcsv' / 'dot' when `joern-export` was used.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Carries the content-addressable handle to the raw CPG artefact and its manifest.

blobHandle.description: Content-addressable URI of the raw CPG artefact in the BundleStore (e.g. 'bb://blackboard/runs/{bbId}/bundles/joern/<sha256>.bin').

partial.description: True when `joern-parse` reported degraded coverage (e.g. parse errors). Consumers MAY still process the CPG but SHOULD downweight downstream confidence.
